articles.author: Sam Meredith
articles.title: Europe is blowing up riverbeds as an extreme drought wreaks havoc on its economy - CNBC
articles.description: Severe drought is disrupting energy and freight across Europe as low Rhine and Danube levels raise risks for supply chains and economic growth.
